title: CompilerSutra Weekly — #004, November 28 2026
week_overview: 01 — The biggest development: Use libcalls for constrained f16 conversions. STRICT_FP16_TO_FP and STRICT_FP_TO_FP16 are not covered by the default. This is backend work with relevance to CPU engineers. Changed tests… (Backend)

02 — Backend and code generation: Clean up classify_argument. Simplify the position arithmetic in classify_argument. Replace. This is backend work with relevance to CPU engineers. Primary audience: CPU… (Backend)

03 — Frontend and language infrastructure: Don't require TypeSystemClang for TLS lookup. DynamicLoaderDarwin::GetThreadLocalData doesn't need to direclty. This is runtime & toolchain work with relevance to Languages engineers… (Runtime & Toolchain)

04 — GPU / accelerator compilers: Add support for __builtin_amdgcn_log_clampf. Adds CIRGen support for `__builtin_amdgcn_log_clampf`, also adds CIR and. This is frontend work for AMDGPU with relevance to GPU engineers… (Frontend)

05 — Also on the radar: Support untyped pointers in Load and Store. This is middle-end work for SPIR-V with relevance to GPU engineers. Changed tests are the reproduce entry point. Primary audience: GPU… (Middle-end)

selectZext lowers G_ZEXT from s1 to an INSERT_SUBREG of IMPLICIT_DEF
followed by an AND. The INSERT_SUBREG result used the full destination
class, but in 32-bit mode only some registers have 8-bit subregisters,
and in 64-bit mode GR64 includes RIP which has none. TwoAddress turns the
INSERT_SUBREG into a sub_8bit def of that register, which fails machine
verification with "Invalid subregister index for virtual register".

selectZext lowers G_ZEXT from s1 to an INSERT_SUBREG of IMPLICIT_DEF
followed by an AND. The INSERT_SUBREG result used the full destination
class, but in 32-bit mode only some registers have 8-bit subregisters,
and in 64-bit mode GR64 includes RIP which has none. TwoAddress turns the
INSERT_SUBREG into a sub_8bit def of that register, which fails machine
verification with "Invalid subregister index for virtual register".
